rules: Ambient words rotate only while the host reports an explicit thinking fact and no wait, block, stop or terminal fact applies.
The first word of every thinking span is always the plain word 'Thinking'.
Screen readers hear 'Thinking' once per thinking span; rotated words are aria-hidden.
Under reduced motion the word stays 'Thinking'.
No word implies progress or remaining time (no 'Almost done', 'Nearly there', 'Finishing up').
